title: College of Nursing - Workload Reports, Course Releases, and Faculty Climate Data

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Texas Public Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Dear Public Information Officer,

Pursuant to the Texas Public Information Act, Texas Government Code Chapter 552, I request copies of the following public records maintained by Texas A&M University (including the Texas A&M Health Science Center and the College of Nursing) regarding faculty workload distribution and retention in the College of Nursing from Fall 2024 through Fall 2026.

1) CBM008 Faculty Workload Reports: Copies of the Texas Higher Education Coordinating Board (THECB) CBM008 faculty reports (and underlying departmental workload assignment spreadsheets) submitted for the College of Nursing for the Fall 2024, Spring 2025, Summer 2025, Fall 2025, Spring 2026, and Fall 2026 semesters.
2) Course Release, Overload, and Stipend Ledgers: Spreadsheets, rosters, or accounting records showing all teaching/clinical course releases, administrative stipends, overload payments, and research buyouts granted to College of Nursing faculty during this period, broken down by faculty rank, track, and campus site (Bryan-College Station vs. Round Rock).
3) Faculty Climate Surveys and Exit Summaries: Finalized summary reports or College of Nursing breakdowns from faculty climate surveys (such as COACHE survey reports), de-identified faculty exit interview summaries, and annual tallies of formal faculty grievances or workload appeals filed with the College of Nursing or the Dean of Faculties.

Please provide these records electronically.

I consent to the redaction of information subject to mandatory statutory exceptions (such as home addresses, personal email addresses, personal telephone numbers under Tex. Gov't Code §§ 552.117 and 552.137, and confidential medical/ADA accommodation details under § 552.101) to expedite processing without requiring an Attorney General ruling. If any portion of these records is withheld, please cite the specific statutory exceptions claimed and release all non-exempt portions.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

OpenRecordsTransparencyTX

title: College of Nursing Search Waivers, Qualification Exceptions, and Hiring Overrides

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Texas Public Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Search Waivers, Qualification Exceptions & Hiring Overrides
Subject: Texas Public Information Act Request – College of Nursing Search Waivers, Qualification Exceptions, and Hiring Overrides

Dear Public Information Officer,

Pursuant to the Texas Public Information Act, Texas Government Code Chapter 552, I request copies of the following public records maintained by Texas A&M University (including the Texas A&M Health Science Center and the College of Nursing) regarding faculty and administrative hiring in the College of Nursing from the start of Dean Horsley's tenure in the College of Nursing at Texas A&M to the present date.

1) Search Committee Waivers: All requests, justifications, and approvals submitted to Human Resources, the Dean of Faculties, or university leadership to waive a competitive search (including direct appointments, opportunity hires, or interim-to-permanent conversions) for any faculty or administrative position in the College of Nursing. Please specifically include the prior Executive Dean position (not the current interim one) and the current Chief Administrative Officer position.
2) Minimum Qualification Exceptions: All requests, memos, and approvals granting an exception or waiver to posted minimum qualifications (such as terminal degree, clinical hours, or administrative experience requirements) for any candidate selected for a College of Nursing faculty or administrative role.
3) Committee Recommendations vs. Final Selections: For all completed College of Nursing faculty and administrative searches during this timeframe, the search committee's written ranked finalist list or recommendation memo alongside the final hiring justification memo signed by the Dean or hiring authority.
4)  Selected Candidate Credentials: The official job postings and the submitted curricula vitae (CVs) or resumes for all individuals hired into College of Nursing faculty or administrative positions during this timeframe.

Please provide these records electronically.

I consent to the redaction of information subject to mandatory statutory exceptions (such as home addresses, personal email addresses, and personal telephone numbers under Tex. Gov't Code §§ 552.117 and 552.137) to expedite processing without requiring an Attorney General ruling. If any portion of these records is withheld, please cite the specific statutory exceptions claimed and release all non-exempt portions.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

OpenRecordsTransparencyTX

title: Texas Public Information Act Request – College of Nursing Dean Midterm Evaluation Records

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Texas Public Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Subject: Texas Public Information Act Request – College of Nursing Dean Midterm Evaluation Records
Dear Public Information Officer,
Pursuant to the Texas Public Information Act, Texas Government Code Chapter 552, I request copies of the following public records maintained by Texas A&M University (including the Office of the Provost, Faculty Affairs, and the Texas A&M Health Science Center) regarding the midterm review and evaluation of the current Dean of the College of Nursing (Dean Horsley) conducted most recently, pursuant to TAMU Standard Administrative Procedure 12.99.99.M0.02 :
1) Completed Midterm Evaluation Report: The finalized midterm review report, summary findings, and final evaluation letter or memo issued by the Provost, Executive Vice President, or Dean review committee.
2) Aggregate Survey Results: The complete statistical and disaggregated summary results of the faculty evaluation survey (broken down by faculty rank, appointment type, and campus site, if applicable), including any non-identifying summary of faculty feedback.
3) Review Committee Charge and Roster: The Provost’s charge letter to the review committee and the roster of committee members appointed to conduct the midterm review. Please note that under Tex. Gov't Code § 552.022(a)(1), a completed report or evaluation made of, for, or by a governmental body is core public information. 
If any portion of these records is withheld, please cite the specific statutory exceptions claimed and release all non-exempt portions.  
Thank you.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

OpenRecordsTransparencyTX
